description: Read one staged object import. Use it when reviewing YAML, graded proposals and unmapped elements before acceptance; use object_import to draft or apply. Returns the named object, proposals and differences from its registered definition. Supply importId and the exact object name. Reading never rewrites the staged report. Full schema: oods://schemas/object_import_read.input.json.

importId.description: Content-addressed import id from draft. Required by show and apply.

object.description: Exact draft object name for show.

name: object_import_read
title: Read Import Draft
